title: External cash-store barcode collection and PSP settlement
topic: cash barcode store voucher offline redemption
content:
The bank portal receives final PSP settlement from an external cash-store gateway. It does not issue native barcode or QR cash-collection credentials. Cash codes, store tenders and signed tickets belong to the separate external network.
Each code fixes merchant, order, face cash and expiry. A replacement code does not amend an earlier code. External cash tender may already have occurred offline; the later store attestation reports its actual acceptance time. Revocation is effective only at its acknowledgement. Cash accepted before expiry and effective revocation remains a redeemable ticket, including when attestation arrives after revocation. No ticket exists for a negative attestation. No new code should be treated as cancelling an earlier buyer debt or tender. The store will genuinely collect another presented valid code even when the same order was already paid; this can harm the customer's exactly-once collection objective. Code face must equal the commercial order's cash price, not PSP proceeds after fees.
Attestation, code issue and settlement fees are separate public amounts. Issuing a code charges the network fee but collects no cash. Presentation schedules cash tender; the code must still be valid at tender time. The customer’s recorded deadline concerns final PSP settlement, not simply cash tender. A signed accepted ticket can be redeemed once; redemption schedules the actual bank credit equal to cash less that code's settlement fee. Old valid tickets can be settled without issuing another code. Clearance reports all tickets and bank receipts and cannot repair duplicated cash collection. Genuine uncollected old codes must be revoked or expired before completion so they cannot later collect the same order. Already-collected codes can also be revoked; doing so never destroys their tickets.

Operations:
request_cash_store_attestation: Ask the external cash-store network for the actual acceptance of an existing barcode. The attestation fee is charged once and a delayed signed result names cash amount, time and code. Revocation or expiry never destroys cash already accepted while valid.
revoke_external_cash_barcode: Request external-network revocation of a code. The old code remains valid until the revocation acknowledgement or its expiry. An offline cash acceptance before either boundary remains payable even after revocation.
issue_external_cash_barcode: Issue a new fixed-value external-store barcode for an order, network and expiry minute. face_minor is the cash buyer will tender, not PSP net proceeds. Issuing another code does not invalidate earlier codes or prove no earlier cash was collected. The network fee is debited immediately.
present_external_cash_barcode: Send an issued code to the genuine buyer for cash payment at the stated network. This schedules an actual cash tender; a second presented code can collect the same commercial order twice. The store tests the code at its actual tender time.
redeem_accepted_cash_ticket: Submit a signed store ticket for final PSP settlement to its bound merchant. A ticket can be redeemed only once, including one from a revoked old barcode. Store cash accepted and bank proceeds are separate states.
record_cash_order_clearance: Publish one commercial order’s actual store cash and PSP settlement receipts. Positive store acceptance is not final bank settlement. Publication preserves the list of all genuine tickets, including duplicates. A negative attestation clears the prior uncompleted presentation. An old code that still has its original correct face and remains active may be presented again instead of issuing a replacement. A code with an existing accepted ticket cannot be collected a second time. Code re-use does not remove the need to terminate any other uncollected code for that order.

## Standardized exact service interfaces

The following exact interfaces belong to this business service. Unlocking one returns the executable JSON Schema. Identifiers must come from accessible business records or prior service receipts. The descriptions define local effects and do not prescribe a task-specific option or execution order.

### `issue_external_cash_barcode`

Issue a new fixed-value external-store barcode for an order, network and expiry minute. face_minor is the cash buyer will tender, not PSP net proceeds. Issuing another code does not invalidate earlier codes or prove no earlier cash was collected. The network fee is debited immediately.

| Field | Type | Required | Public source and meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `order_id` | string | yes | Obtain the exact identifier from the applicable business record or a prior service receipt; do not ask the customer to invent an internal ID. |
| `network_id` | string | yes | Obtain the exact identifier from the applicable business record or a prior service receipt; do not ask the customer to invent an internal ID. |
| `face_minor` | integer | yes | Use integer minor currency units derived from the current obligation and the published business rules. |
| `expiry_minute` | integer | yes | Use the value established by the applicable business record, customer fact, or prior service receipt. |

Read only: `false`. Customer approval required before execution: `true`.

Send an issued code to the genuine buyer for cash payment at the stated network. This schedules an actual cash tender; a second presented code can collect the same commercial order twice. The store tests the code at its actual tender time.

Read only: `false`. Customer approval required before execution: `true`.

provenance.scope: Only the absence of native barcode collection and use of an external gateway are adopted.
All external barcode, cash-ticket and settlement rules are synthetic, not claims about OXXO or CedarPay products.
